questions.question: If a 9-digit number 609a5b9c9 is divisible by 99, then (a + b + c) is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divisibility by 99 means the number must be divisible by both 9 and 11.

Sum of digits: 38 + (a + b + c) must be a multiple of 9 → (a + b + c) = 7, 16, 25.

Alternate sum difference: 38 − (a + b + c) must be a multiple of 11.

Testing option A: 38 − 16 = 22 (divisible by 11) and 38 + 16 = 54 (divisible by 9).

Other options (7, 26, 25) do not satisfy the divisibility rule for 11.

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 9-digit number 609a5b9c9 is divisible by 99.

**Formula Used:** Divisibility rules for 9 (sum of digits) and 11 (difference of alternating sums).

questions.question: In triangleABC, ∠B = 87° and ∠C = 60°. Points D and E are on the sides AB and AC, respectively, such that ∠DEC = 93° and DE ∶ BC = 5 ∶ 9. If AB = 14.4 cm, then the length of AE is:
questions.solution:
Given:

ΔABC, ∠B = 87° and ∠C = 60

∠DEC = 93° and DE ∶ BC = 5 ∶ 9.

AB = 14.4 cm

Concept used:

The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°

The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is 360°

The ratios of the corresponding sides of similar triangles are the same. 

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63151443f82a151f002614d7591ef8790e7bd60f62e49e754bdd183a50dee0f0.png] 

Considering, ΔABC, ∠A = 180° - 87° - 60° = 33° 

Now, considering the quadrilateral BCED,

∠EDB = 360° - 93° - 60° - 87° = 120°

Hence, 

ADB being a straight line, ∠ADE = 180° - 120° = 60°

AEC being a straight line, ∠AED = 180° - 93° = 87°

Hence, ΔADE and ΔACB are similar triangles.

Now,

DE/BC = AE/AB

⇒ AE = (DE/BC) × AB

⇒ AE = 5/9 × 14.4

⇒ AE = 8

**∴ The length of AE is 8 cm.**

questions.question: The average weight of some members of a club is 70 kg. If 15 members with an average weight of 60 kg join the club or 5 members with an average weight of 90 kg leave the club, then the average weight of members in both cases is equal. How many members were there in the club initially?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of some members of a club is 70 kg

**Concept Used:**

Average = Sum of all observation/no of observation

**Calculation:**

Let x be the members were there in the club initially

According to question

⇒ (70x + 15 x 60)/(x + 15) = (70x - 5 x 90)/(x - 5)

⇒ (70x + 900x)/(x + 15) = (70x - 450)/(x -5)

= (70x² + 900x - 350x - 4500) = 70x² - 450x + 1050x - 6750

= (550x - 4500) = (600x - 6750)

= (6750 - 4500) = 50x

= 2250 = 50x

x = 45

**Therefore, the members were there in the club initially is 45**

questions.question: What is the area (in hectares) of a rhombus-shaped field whose side is 146 m and one of its diagonals is 192 m?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Side = 146 m

Diagonal = 192 m

**Concept Used:**

Area = 1/2(p×q)

Here, p and q is the diagonal of the rhombus

⇒ 4a² = p² + q²

Where, a is the side of the rhombus

A = (1/2) psqrt{4a²-p²}

**Calculation:**

A = (1/2) x 192 sqrt{4(146)²-(192)²}

= (1/2) × 192 sqrt{85264 - 36864}

= (1/2) × 192 sqrt{48400}

= (1/2) × 192 × 220

= (1/2) × 42240

= 21120 m²

Divide the area value by 10000 to convert in hectare =** 2.112 hectares**

**Therefore, the area (in hectares) of a rhombus-shaped field is 2.112 hectares**

questions.question: The value of frac{{(tan 25^circ cot 65^circ - cose{c²} 65^circ ) + co{t²} 61^circ - se{c²} 29^circ }}{{si{n²} 5^circ + si{n²} 7^circ + si{n²} 9^circ + ·s + si{n²} 85^circ }} is:
questions.solution:
Given:

frac{{(tan 25^circ cot 65^circ - cose{c²} 65^circ ) + co{t²} 61^circ - se{c²} 29^circ }}{{si{n²} 5^circ + si{n²} 7^circ + si{n²} 9^circ + ·s + si{n²} 85^circ }}

Concept used:

sinθ = cos (90° - θ)

tan θ = cot (90° - θ)

cosec² θ - cot² θ = 1

sec² θ - tan² θ = 1

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1

sin 45° = 1/√2

Calculation:

Taking the denominator first,

Sin² 5° + Sin2 7° + Sin2 9° + .... + Sin2 85°

⇒ (Sin2 5° + Sin2 85°) + (Sin2 7° + Sin2 83°) + (Sin2 9° + Sin2 81°) + .... + Sin2 45°

⇒ (Sin2 5° + Cos2 (90° - 85°))+ (Sin2 7° + Cos2 (90°- 83°) + (Sin2 9° + Cos2 (90° - 81°)) + .... + Sin2 45°

⇒ (Sin2 5° + Cos2 5°)+ (Sin2 7° + Cos2 7°) + (Sin2 9° + Cos2 9°) + .... + Sin2 45°

⇒ 20 + 1/2 (∵ From 5° to 85° there are 20 such odd pairs and one single term standing)

⇒ 20.5

Now, taking the numerator.

tan 25° Cot 65° - cosec² 65° + cot² 61° - sec² 29°

⇒ Cot (90 - 25)° Cot 65° - cosec2 65° + tan2 (90 - 61)° - sec2 29°

⇒ (Cot² 65° - cosec2 65°) + (tan² 29° - sec2 29°)

⇒ - 1 - 1

⇒ (- 2)

Hence,

frac{{(tan 25^circ cot 65^circ - cose{c²} 65^circ ) + co{t²} 61^circ - se{c²} 29^circ }}{{si{n²} 5^circ + si{n²} 7^circ + si{n²} 9^circ + ·s + si{n²} 85^circ }}

⇒ (- 2)/20.5

⇒ (-4/41)

**∴ The required value of frac{{(tan 25^circ cot 65^circ - cose{c²} 65^circ ) + co{t²} 61^circ - se{c²} 29^circ }}{{si{n²} 5^circ + si{n²} 7^circ + si{n²} 9^circ + ·s + si{n²} 85^circ }} is {-4 over 41}.**

questions.question: The ratio of the ages of A and B is 3 ∶ 4. Four years ago, the ratio of their ages was 5 ∶ 7. What will be the ratio of the ages of A and B four years from now?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of ages of A and B = 3 : 4

four years ago the ratio of their ages = 5 : 7

**Calculation:**

Ages of A and B = 3x and 4x

So, four years ago their ages = 3x - 4 and 4x - 4

ATQ

(3x - 4)/(4x - 4) = 5/7

By solving this we get, 

⇒ x = 8

Ages of A and B = 3 x 8 and 4 x 8

 = 24 and 32

Their ages after four years from now = 28 and 36

Ration of their ages after four years from now = 7 : 9

**Therefore, the ratio of ages of A and B four years from now is 7 : 9**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to ₹ 11,520 in 4 years at the rate of 15% p.a. simple interest. what will be the amount of the same sum in 2 years at the same rate, if the interest is compounded 8-monthly (nearest to a ₹)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount = ₹ 11,520 

T = 4 years, R = 15% p.a. simple interest

**Concept Used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P is principal, r is rate of interest 

If p be the principal, r be the rate of interest then the interest compounded 8 monthly then compound interest will be P x [(1 + r/100)³ - 1]

**Calculation:**

SI = PRT/100

= P x 15 x (4/100)

= 3P/5

Amount = P + SI

⇒ 11520 = P + 3P/5

⇒ P = 7200

Time = 3years (compounded 8 monthly)

Rate = 15/12 x 8 = 10%

CI = P x [(1 + r/100)3 - 1]

= 7200 x [(1 + 10/100)3 - 1]

= 2383

Amount = 7200 + 2383

= 9583

**Therefore, the amount of the same sum in 2 years at the same rate, if the interest is compounded 8-monthly is ₹9583**
